bull.b: Positive Phase 1 biomarker and safety results provide initial human validation for Axiomer RNA editing. This can strengthen the platform’s scientific credibility, support advancement of AX-0811 and improve partnering potential across additional genetic and liver-disease programs.

The financing and Lilly’s continued participation provide resources to fund clinical development through multiple upcoming milestones. A runway into mid-2028 reduces near-term financing pressure and gives management more time to generate value from the pipeline.

Revenue growth and very high gross margins indicate improving collaboration or partnering economics and potential operating leverage as programs advance. Although revenue is not yet product-based, this trend supports the platform’s ability to attract commercial funding.

bear.b: ProQR remains structurally unprofitable despite revenue growth, reflecting the high cost of discovery and clinical development. Continued losses could consume equity and limit strategic flexibility unless partnerships, milestones or eventual product revenues scale materially.

Heavy operating and free-cash-flow deficits show that the business does not yet fund itself internally. Ongoing clinical investment will likely require additional partnerships or financing, creating dilution and execution risk if development timelines extend.

The company’s pipeline remains investigational, so revenue is concentrated in collaborations rather than recurring product sales. Failure, delay or unfavorable results in clinical programs could weaken partnering income and postpone the transition to sustainable commercial cash generation.
